name: Browse the Deentok Islamic feed
description: Verifies visitors can browse the curated Islamic feed and narrow it by category.
expected: The feed shows Islamic posts, the Quran filter narrows the list, and the selected post shows its category and source note.

name: Create a video post
description: Verifies a valid Islamic post can be published and remains visible after refreshing.
steps: Enter a title, select a category, and provide a valid video URL
expected: The new post appears in the feed after publishing and remains visible after refresh.

name: Save and like a post
description: Verifies the feed's engagement controls are usable on a mobile viewport.
expected: The post's like state updates and the saved post appears in the Saved view.

name: Validate a post before publishing
description: Verifies incomplete or invalid post details are rejected with a clear message.
steps: Leave the title empty or enter an invalid video URL
expected: A clear validation message appears and no new post is added.
